main_text.p: mi feculi effe videatur & ante conftitu-tum Ecclefiarum confenfu Canonem fcri-pta, Clementifque nomen præfe ferat, al-terius tamen Clementis effe antiqui judi-cárunt.

67. Hujus vero M S. licet magnus fit cum Vaticano confenfus, adeo ut fe mutuo con-firment, omniaque argumenta quæ à Mo-rino proferuntur ad probandam Vaticani fin-ceritatem, etiam huic noftro quadrent; cum tamen illud ex Luciani Martyris, hoc ve-ro ex Hefychii editione multis effe videatur: Hefychii enim exemplaria Alexandriæ in ufu publico erant tefte Hieronymo, unde in minutis quibufdam, varietates quædam oc-currunt, præfertim in propriis nominibus, in quibus frequentior inter exemplaria diffen-fus reperitur; cumque textum codicis no-ftri Alexandrini imprimere effet fere actum agere. idem enim fere eft cum Vaticano, præter dignitatem tamen tanti & tam celebris MS. effet, inter varias aliorum codicum lectiones ad finem cujuslibet Tomi, vel ad calcem to-tius operis detrudi, ideo ut uno intuitu ifta duo nobiliff: & antiquifsima exemplaria lectori repræfentarentur, Romanum primo in columna peculiari pofuimus, Alexandrinum vero ad fi-nem cujuflibet columnæ, ubi fcil. à Romano differt, ut hoc modo lector collationem inter u-trumque facere poffet. Lectiones etiam iftas ex MS.

page.notes: The "MS." at the foot right is the catchword, not a heading. A small mark at the bottom left corner is unclear and was left out. The italic "Mo-rino" is the printed name of Morinus, set in italic. Words set in italic in the main text are marked with <i> where they are clear. The word "agere" is followed by a mark that could be a comma or a full stop; it is written as a full stop.
